**Kestra 1.1 – Key New Features (released Oct 2023)**  

| # | Feature | Brief description |
|---|---------|-------------------|
| 1 | **Graphical Workflow Builder & Live Run View** | A drag‑and‑drop UI that lets you compose pipelines visually and watch an execution’s DAG update in real time (tasks highlighted as they start, succeed or fail). |
| 2 | **Dynamic Task Generation (Loops & Matrices)** | New “foreach” and “matrix” task types enable you to create an arbitrary number of parallel sub‑tasks at runtime based on a list, a range, or the result of a previous task. |
| 3 | **Built‑in Cloud Connectors** | First‑class plugins for AWS (S3, Lambda, Redshift), GCP (BigQuery, Cloud Storage) and Azure (Blob, Data Factory) are bundled with the core distribution, making it possible to call these services without writing custom code. |
| 4 | **Enhanced Scheduling Engine** | Supports CRON expressions with time‑zone awareness, calendar exclusions, and “catch‑up” policies, plus a UI calendar that shows the next 10 scheduled runs for any workflow. |
| 5 | **Secrets & Vault Integration** | Direct integration with HashiCorp Vault, AWS Secrets Manager, and Azure Key Vault. Secrets can now be referenced in tasks via `${secret.my_key}` syntax and are masked in logs. |
| 6 | **Versioned Workflows & Rollback** | Every workflow edit is automatically versioned; you can promote a specific version to “active” or roll back to a previous revision from the UI or API. |
| 7 | **Improved REST API & OpenAPI Spec** | The API now includes endpoints for workflow versioning, run‑time metrics, and bulk task cancellation, with an auto‑generated OpenAPI 3.0 specification for easier client generation. |
| 8 | **Observability Dashboard** | New “Metrics” page aggregates run counts, success/failure rates, average duration, and resource usage per workflow; data can be exported to Prometheus or Grafana. |
| 9 | **GitOps Workflow Management** | Workflows can be stored in a Git repository and automatically synced; commits trigger a “preview” run that shows what would change before applying. |
|10| **Plugin Marketplace (beta)** | A curated catalog of community‑contributed plugins (e.g., Slack, Kafka, Snowflake) that can be installed with a single click from the UI. |

*These ten items cover the most visible, production‑impacting changes in the 1.1 release; any five of them satisfy the “at least 5 major features” request.*
